scope: Capture-only stationary text stabilization, recent-cost scheduling and shared CoreML GPU synthesis/color fixes

compute.note: System schedules actual CPU/GPU/ANE utilization; no forced 100% claim

capture_text.detection: Asynchronous geometric text rectangles, at most once per second, no OCR
capture_text.preserves: Original source frames, generated pixels outside text regions and actual interpolated motion
capture_text.native_gpu_batch: Apple and MetalFX append to existing GPU command, no new frame queue
capture_text.other_backends: CoreML and RifeMetal apply bounded per-worker GPU scratch

tests.capture_text: passed; actual Apple576 and MetalFX, static colored strokes, source identity, outside-ROI exact pixels, genuine midpoint motion, moving-text bypass
tests.source_blend_kernel: passed; boundary/non-integer scaling/FP16 equivalence and 601/709/2020 full/video color roundtrips
tests.apple_sessions: passed; independent capture and file sessions
tests.rifemetal_detail: passed; genuine midframe and original identity
tests.yuvs_gpu_conversion: passed; every Y/UV byte at 1080p/1440p/2160p plus padding/range/reset checks
tests.ui: Capture settings panel visibly shows checked stationary-text control; normal app relaunched without diagnostic arguments

real_game_replay.input: 16 previously recorded 1920x1080 NV12 frames; no live UVC source
real_game_replay.metric: Stable bright stroke luma absolute error vs source-pair mean, code values 0-255; not full-frame perceptual ground truth

limitations: No current capture device, USB-to-display latency or long-run gameplay verification
Timed replay P95 exceeds 16.7ms, so no guaranteed sustained 120 FPS
Text detection may miss fonts; unsupported formats retain model output
NV12 midframe 4:2:0 chroma can differ from YUVS source 4:2:2 for tiny colored strokes
Low-resolution inference can still soften non-text regions or cause occlusion artifacts
